title: An Ext denominator criterion for integral models of an extension
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=\mathcal O_E$ and $\varpi$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-pc-scheme]; noetherian means a finite affine cover by spectra of noetherian rings, and finite-dimensional means a finite bound on lengths of strict chains of irreducible closed subsets. Write $A_Y(V)=C(|V|,A)$ and $E_Y(V)=C(|V|,E)$ on the small pro-etale site of any locally closed subscheme $Y$ of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use sheaf modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $S_Y(M)=E_Y\otimes_{A_Y}M$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Constructible integral means continuous-constructible as in [def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module], with local models $A_Y\otimes_A P$ for finitely presented $A$-modules $P$ on finitely many locally closed strata. Let $P,Q$ be constructible integral $A_X$-module sheaves. Use Ext in the module-sheaf derived categories [def-pc-ext] and localization of an $A$-module at powers of $\varpi$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Suppose that the scalar-extension map
$$\operatorname{Ext}^1_{A_X}(P,Q)[1/\varpi]\longrightarrow\operatorname{Ext}^1_{E_X}(S_XP,S_XQ),\qquad \alpha/\varpi^m\longmapsto\varpi^{-m}S_X(\alpha)$$
is surjective. For every short exact sequence $0\to S_XQ\to F\to S_XP\to0$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence], there exists a constructible integral $A_X$-module sheaf $N$ and an isomorphism $S_XN\cong F$. No compatibility with the prescribed inclusion of $S_XQ$ is required.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13, last paragraph, clearing a denominator in an extension class; Stacks Tag 06XV (derived.tex, lemma-ext-1) for degree-one extension classification.

proof.text: Identify the coefficient rings before using scalar extension. The canonical isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction] identify $A_X$ with $\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_X$ and identify the actual inclusion $A_X\to E_X$ with $A_X\to A_X[1/\varpi]$. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-scalar-localization-sheaf-exact], with $R=A_X$ and $s=\varpi$, says that $S_X=E_X\otimes_{A_X}-$ is an exact additive functor on the ambient abelian categories of module sheaves. The coefficient identifications apply because $X$ is noetherian; the localization exactness lemma has no additional geometric hypothesis.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13, final paragraph; Proposition 6.8.11(1),(3); denominator argument expanded using Stacks Tags 06XV and 0152.

proof.text: Write the given sequence as $\mathcal E:0\to S_XQ\xrightarrow{u}F\xrightarrow{v}S_XP\to0$. By [lem-weil-pbc-ext-one-extension-classification] it has a class $\xi\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_{E_X}(S_XP,S_XQ)$. Surjectivity in the hypothesis supplies a preimage. Every element of the localized module is a fraction by [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away], so choose $m\geq0$ and $\alpha\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_{A_X}(P,Q)$ with $\xi=\varpi^{-m}S_X(\alpha)$. Consequently $S_X(\alpha)=\varpi^m\xi$. This uses the specified scalar-extension map, rather than an unspecified isomorphism of Ext groups.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13, final paragraph; Proposition 6.8.11(1),(3); denominator argument expanded using Stacks Tags 06XV and 0152.

proof.text: Apply the surjective direction of [lem-weil-pbc-ext-one-extension-classification] in the ambient category of $A_X$-module sheaves to $\alpha$. Obtain an actual short exact sequence $\mathcal A:0\to Q\xrightarrow{i}N\xrightarrow{p}P\to0$ whose connecting class is $\alpha$. This assertion does not yet claim constructibility of $N$; that is checked separately in the next step.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13, final paragraph; Proposition 6.8.11(1),(3); denominator argument expanded using Stacks Tags 06XV and 0152.

proof.text: To verify the required notion of constructibility, use the completed-ring isomorphism in [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction]. The complexes $Q[0]$ and $P[0]$ satisfy condition (iii) of [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]: they are bounded, their sole cohomology sheaves are $Q,P$, and their finite stratifications with local models $A_X\otimes_A M$ are exactly those in the hypothesis. Here the coefficient restriction to each stratum agrees with the continuous coefficient ring by the same immersion-restriction lemma. Regard $\mathcal A$ as a degreewise short exact sequence of degree-zero complexes. By [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle] it gives a distinguished triangle $Q[0]\to N[0]\to P[0]\to Q[0][1]$. The full subcategory in the characterization is closed under shifts and cones, hence contains $N[0]$ as well (rotate this triangle to $P[0][-1]\to Q[0]\to N[0]$). Applying condition (iii) back to $N[0]$ proves that $N$ is continuous-constructible with ordinary finitely presented $A$-module local models. The finite-extension, noetherian, finite-dimensional, and invertibility hypotheses of the characterization are precisely assumed here; no local freeness or torsion-freeness of $P,Q$ is used.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13, final paragraph; Proposition 6.8.11(1),(3); denominator argument expanded using Stacks Tags 06XV and 0152.

proof.text: Exactness from step 1 sends $\mathcal A$ to $0\to S_XQ\xrightarrow{S_Xi}S_XN\xrightarrow{S_Xp}S_XP\to0$. By the exact-functor compatibility in [lem-weil-pbc-ext-one-extension-classification], its class is $S_X(\alpha)=\varpi^m\xi$. Define another short exact sequence $\mathcal E_m$ with the same middle and quotient sheaves as $\mathcal E$, but inclusion $u_m=u\circ(\varpi^{-m}\operatorname{id}_{S_XQ})$. It is short exact because the scalar factor is an automorphism. The triple $(\varpi^m\operatorname{id}_{S_XQ},\operatorname{id}_F,\operatorname{id}_{S_XP})$ is a morphism $\mathcal E\to\mathcal E_m$, since $u_m\circ\varpi^m=u$ and $v\circ\operatorname{id}_F=\operatorname{id}_{S_XP}\circ v$. Naturality of the connecting morphism in [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle], applied to the corresponding degree-zero complexes, gives $[\mathcal E_m]=(\varpi^m\operatorname{id}_{S_XQ})[1]\circ\xi=\varpi^m\xi$. Scalar multiplication here is postcomposition by the shifted scalar map, the usual module action on derived Ext.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13, final paragraph; Proposition 6.8.11(1),(3); denominator argument expanded using Stacks Tags 06XV and 0152.

proof.text: The rationalization of $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal E_m$ now have the same endpoints and the same degree-one Ext class. The injective direction of [lem-weil-pbc-ext-one-extension-classification] gives an isomorphism $h:S_XN\xrightarrow{\sim}F$ with $h\circ S_Xi=u_m$ and $v\circ h=S_Xp$. The constructibility of $N$ was proved in step 4, so this is the requested integral model. The formula for $u_m$ explains exactly why the result asserts no compatibility with the originally prescribed inclusion $u$.

Step 4: P[0] and Q[0] satisfy (iii) of the stratified characterization, whose hypotheses are all in the item. The ses-triangle node and closure under shifts and cones put N[0] in the subcategory, so N is constructible. Step 5: the exact-functor clause gives class ϖ^mξ. With u_m=u∘ϖ^{-m}, (ϖ^m,id,id) is a morphism E→E_m, and triangleOfSES naturality gives [E_m]=ϖ^m[1]∘ξ. The classification node's boundary is the same triangleOfSES δ (its steps 4–5, extClass_hom), and the direction of the rescaling is correct. Step 6: the injective half of classification gives S_XN≅F. Edge cases m=0, ξ=0, torsion α, P=0 or Q=0 and empty X are fine. The DAG search (rg -L for '6.8.13' and 'closed under extensions'+constructible) found no node stating this criterion.
